answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the forge of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The jade holds work receipts rather than names, so the harbor of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, capped per identity per epoch, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
